name: Enterprise Crucible Myth
axiom: Culture is what the organisation did when the cost was real.
trigger: Culture handbooks and leadership transitions, where stated values need a decision behind them.

steps.text: Constraint: the situation that left no easy option.
Threat: what the organisation stood to lose.
Stand: the decision that cost something to make.
Moral: the value it now stands for, in one line.

antiPattern.violation: A list of aspirational values with no story attached, which the reader can neither remember nor test a decision against.
antiPattern.remediation: Attach one real decision to each value. A value with no cost attached is a preference.

parametricParams.caption: A VALUE NEEDS A COST BEHIND IT
